test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who inaugurated 'Destination North East 2020', to showcase the region's culture, tourism and heritage?

options.text: Union Minister for Tourism and Culture, Prahlad Singh Patel
Union Minister for Tourism, Dr Jitendra Singh

solution:
The correct answer is __**Union Home Minister, Amit Shah**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Destination North East 2020** is an annual festival to promote and showcase the** region’s tourism, culture, heritage and business**.
 
• It is organised by the **Ministry of Development of Northeast Region (DONER)**.
 
• Its aim is to promote **national integration**.
 
• **North Eastern Council (NEC)** is its nodal agency.
 
• It covers **8 North-Eastern States Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim and Tripura**.
 
• Union Home Minister,** Amit Shah** inaugurated it for the development of N-E states.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** **__​Projects and Scheme For North East India__**

 
• **Digital North East Vision 2022** for the development of digital technology to ease the life of northeast people.
 
• **Kaladan Multi-Modal Transit Project** to connect the northeast state with **Myanmar and South East Asian countries**.
 
• **Mission Purvodaya** to establish the **steel sector** in North East states.
